Name: Open grandMA3 Deck
Author: Fredrik Fedoriw
Description: Turn your Stream Deck into a grandMA3 command wing and executor extension. Attribute encoders with layers and MAtricks on the Stream Deck + and + XL dials, a full command keypad, executors with live feedback, names and encoder banks read from your show, pools, pages, colour picker and window keys. Talks to grandMA3 onPC and consoles over plain OSC: no extra software, no licences. Free and open source (MIT). Not affiliated with MA Lighting.

Actions.Name: MA Key
Actions.Tooltip: A grandMA3 hard key: numbers, Store, Update, At, Thru, Please, Clear, Highlight, Blind and more.

Actions.Name: Command Line
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the command you are typing. Tap to send it (Please), hold to clear it.

Actions.Name: Command / Macro
Actions.Tooltip: Sends any grandMA3 command on press and release, alternates two commands as a toggle, or types text into the command line.

Actions.Name: Executor Key
Actions.Tooltip: An executor button with its name and live level from grandMA3. While you type Store, Delete, Label and so on, it completes the command with this executor.

Actions.Name: Pool Object
Actions.Tooltip: Calls a group, preset, sequence, macro, world and more, showing its name from grandMA3. While you type a command, it completes the command with this object.

Actions.Name: Encoder Bank
Actions.Tooltip: Chooses what the attribute encoders control. Banks are built from your grandMA3 patch (Dimmer, Position, Gobo, Color, Beam, Focus…), and the feature group follows on grandMA3. Press again for the next encoder page.

Actions.Name: Encoder Page
Actions.Tooltip: Scrolls the active encoder bank to its next or previous set of attributes.

Actions.Name: Encoder Resolution
Actions.Tooltip: Switches the encoders between coarse, fine and ultra resolution.

Actions.Name: Encoder Layer
Actions.Tooltip: Makes the attribute encoders change Fade, Delay, Speed, Phase, Width, Accel, Decel or Transition instead of the value.

Actions.Name: MAtricks
Actions.Tooltip: Sets MAtricks of the current selection: blocks, groups, wings, width, shift, shuffle, fade and delay ranges. Includes reset.

Actions.Name: Color Picker
Actions.Tooltip: Sends the key's colour to the selected fixtures, or selects a group and colours it in one press. No preset needed.

Actions.Name: Window / Menu
Actions.Tooltip: Opens a grandMA3 menu, overlay or window: Command, MAtricks, Phaser Editor, Playbacks, Masters, Store options and more.

Actions.Name: Executor Page
Actions.Tooltip: Page up, page down or jump to a page, for your executor keys and dials and on grandMA3.

Actions.Name: Connection Status
Actions.Tooltip: Shows OSC traffic to and from grandMA3. Press to send the test command, hold to sync names from grandMA3.

Actions.Name: Session
Actions.Tooltip: Switches every action to a saved connection, such as local onPC, the FOH console or a backup. Hold to sync names from grandMA3.

Actions.Name: Attribute Encoder
Actions.Tooltip: Adjusts an attribute of the selected fixtures: its value, or its fade, delay, speed, phase or width. Follows the active encoder bank, or stays on one attribute.

Actions.Name: Executor Fader
Actions.Tooltip: An executor fader on a dial, with its level shown on the touch strip.

Actions.Name: Command Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Steps through the selection, changes executor page, runs Go+ / Go-, sets a value from a template, or sends your own commands.

Actions.Name: MAtricks Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to set a MAtricks value of the selection, such as wings or blocks. Tap to switch axis.
